prompts.cavernPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: painted background panorama for Holy Diver NES 2x HD remake, Demonic Palace cavern approach. Create a wide 1536x1024 dark Gothic underground scene, side-on 2D game backdrop with no foreground platforms, no characters, no text. A subterranean palace undercroft swallowed by broad ancient volcanic roots and cavern stone, huge distant pointed arch recesses and sparse bone-like ribbed buttresses visible in the darkness. Black plum and midnight indigo rock, restrained cold slate/teal reflected light, faint deep amber glow from distant fissures. Entire image enclosed underground; no sky or moon. Broader shapes and atmospheric depth, finely painted stone texture like polished 16-bit Gothic fantasy box art but suitable for reduction to 768x480. Keep middle and lower space dark and unobtrusive behind bright game actors, outer edge detail moderate. No lava pools or waterfalls painted into background; animated gameplay lava will be overlaid separately. No close ledges or horizontal lines that could appear walkable. Seamless left/right mood, continuous distant architecture across canvas. Opaque full image.
prompts.interiorPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: opaque painted game background for Holy Diver HD remake, Demonic Palace vertical inner chamber. Wide 1536x1024 image, flat side-on view of vast dark enclosed Gothic demonic palace. Tall black burgundy and navy stone pointed arches, repeating distant vault ribs, carved bone tracery and deep recesses, very subtle crimson lighting and cold blue ambient depth. Beautiful ominous high quality hand-painted Gothic fantasy game environment, intricate but broad architectural forms that read at 768x480. The lower two thirds show shadowy distant archways, not floor or walkable ledges; the upper part has looming vaulted stone, no sky. Keep the entire environment subdued, mid-value details in edges with a dark center so bright crimson gameplay columns can appear in foreground. No foreground pillars obscuring play, no characters, no platforms, no text, no candles close to camera, no lava built into image. Bone ornament and dark crimson stone distinguish this from a gold temple or green forest. Continuous lateral composition suitable for stationary backdrop in a scrolling vertical shaft.
prompts.pillarPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated reusable foreground column game art, Holy Diver Demonic Palace. One tall narrow perfectly straight vertical cylindrical pillar, full-length, seen straight-on orthographic with no perspective, centered on transparent background. At the very top a flat pale aged ivory/bone capital provides a clearly horizontal walkable platform edge, carved with a small elegant horned-skull relief directly beneath the flat top. Bottom ends in a simple matching narrow shaft section; no wide base. Native gameplay requires a constant slim width: no horizontal protrusions. Intricate hand-painted Gothic game asset, crisp silhouette, suitable for reduction to a 32-pixel-wide column with 16-pixel repeating shaft units. Moderate detail, strong light upper left and dark right edge. No text, no shadow on ground, no environment, no particles. Entire object inside image, generous transparent margin.
prompts.skeletonPrompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a THREE-FRAME horizontal animation reference sheet for Holy Diver HD Demonic Palace's floating skeleton enemy. The attached native reference is the anatomical silhouette and exact POSE guide, not a style guide. Paint the SAME compact humanoid skeleton in each of the three poses shown, facing LEFT: large low forward skull at left, hunched ribcage in middle, one bent bony limb arches high above the skull, other bony arm trails to the right, lower bent leg hangs beneath the ribcage. It is a humanoid SKELETON, no wings, no cloak, no armor, no flames. Frame1 has the high raised limb and dangling leg; Frame2 lowers the raised limb toward left but keeps the lower leg; Frame3 keeps raised limb and tucks lower leg upward. Preserve the native unusual compact sideways posture. Pale aged ivory bones with cobalt/slate blue shadows, small black eye socket, thin muted cyan eye point, readable ribs and joints, dark outline. Painted Gothic 2D game sprite quality, simple enough at 64x64. Keep head and torso in IDENTICAL locations and identical scale in all frames; only specified limb changes. Wide 1536x1024 transparent sheet, equal square pose areas in one row with large transparent gaps, no labels, no grid, no background or shadows. Each full body inside its area. Anatomy should match the native union closely rather than a conventional standing skeleton. Include ONE small isolated vertical ivory bone projectile below the central pose, separate from the characters.
prompts.stonePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless foreground stone texture for a Gothic 2D platform game, Demonic Palace cavern approach.
